Lionel Messi's Father Jorge Messi Dies at 68

Jorge Messi, the father of football superstar Lionel Messi, has died at the age of 68. He was also his son's first coach and later served as his agent, managing his career and business affairs. News of his passing was confirmed by various outlets, with some mentioning a prolonged illness. A teammate of Lionel Messi also paid tribute.
